_comment: Copy to exits.config.json and edit. Consumed by tools/exits.js.
Windows Defender flags it (Trojan:Win32/Suschil!rfn, a heuristic
detection), so the folder holding it needs a Defender exclusion or
the binary will be quarantined on extraction.
identity + keystore: one payment identity shared by every node, so the
MYST top-up happens once. keystore is the folder holding its
UTC--... file; each node gets a copy.
Ports are assigned by position: node i listens on tequilapi 4060+i and
exposes its HTTP proxy on 1081+i. Reordering this list reshuffles
them, so append rather than insert.
Keep timezone/locale consistent with the country: a London exit
reporting America/New_York is a bigger tell than no proxy at all.
